achievement.1.description: Siz shubhali joylarni ko'rasiz va boshqa odamlarning kundaliklarini, ayniqsa vampirlar haqidagi hikoyalarni o'qishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Siz shuningdek, tokenlarni to‘plovchi va tadqiqotchisiz. Hurmat!
achievement.1.name: Castlemania
achievement.2.description: Lalalala... endi Ozodlik ko‘rfazida aytiladigan kult madhiyasini yoddan bilasiz. Asosan ikkita nota va takrorlanuvchi so'zlardan iborat ekanligini hisobga olsak, unchalik qiyin emas.
achievement.2.name: Xorist
achievement.3.name: Sog'uvchi
achievement.4.description: Siz har doim isyonchi bo'lgansiz - tan oling! Mahbuslarni ta'minlash, chetlanganlarga g'amxo'rlik qilish, boylardan o'g'irlik qilish va kambag'allarga berish - kutish kerak emas, bu boshqa voqea edi.
achievement.4.name: Qarshilik bilan yashang
achievement.5.description: Oddiy jambon va non sizni faqat kuldiradi. Siz g'ayrioddiy, pishloq erituvchi, ko'rshapalak qanotlarini qovuruvchi va shayklarning ustasisiz. Mazali!
achievement.5.name: Pazandachilik ustasi
achievement.6.description: Katta dengiz chig'anoqlarida yuzta chiroyli marvarid topdingiz. Hozirgacha bu marjon tugatilishi kerak - va umid qilamanki, jarayon davomida barmoqlaringizni tez-tez qisib qo'ymagansiz.
achievement.6.name: Shell Searcher
achievement.7.description: Agar kimdir tasodifiy joyda tasodifiy narsani yo'qotib qo'ygan bo'lsa, siz nima va qaerdan bilmasangiz ham, uni so'rash va topish uchun yaxshi odamsiz.
achievement.7.name: Turist xalta
achievement.8.description: Siz boshqalar o'rnatgan va dunyoni o'zingiz yoqtirgan holda shakllantiradigan qoidalarga ahamiyat bermaysiz. Ma'nosiz konventsiyalar va axloqlarni qoldirib, siz faqat o'zingiz ega bo'lgan kuchni qadrlaysiz. Siz o'z taqdiringizning ustasisiz va dunyoni tozalash uchun kurashasiz.
achievement.8.name: Qo'rqinchli Rabbiy
achievement.9.description: Siz o'zingizni isbotladingiz - nafaqat tushingizda - va kuchli va ruhiy aqlga egasiz. Sizning jinlar va o'lmagan vaboga qarshi mardonavor kurashingiz sizga Nightmare Knights orasida eng yuqori va eng hurmatli darajani berdi.
achievement.9.name: Lord Protector
achievement.10.description: Siz orzular va mas'uliyat yo'lidan o'zingizni o'ylaydigan kuchsiz yurasiz. Ochko'zlik va xudbinlikdan ozod bo'lib, siz boshqalarga mukofot kutmasdan yordam berasiz.
achievement.10.name: Nightmare Knight
achievement.11.description: Siz o'lmagan suyak aka-ukalariga qo'shildingiz - o'limni dushmaningiz va qurolingizga aylantirdingiz. Kuchsiz narsani yutib yuborish va kuchliga joy qoldirish sizning asosiy maqsadingizdir.
achievement.11.name: Suyak aka
achievement.12.description: Siz deyarli ma'nosiz ibodat uchun dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qildingiz - lekin hech bo'lmaganda buni takrorlashingiz shart emas va ko'z ochib yumguncha yangi muborak qoziqni olishingiz mumkin.
achievement.12.name: Muborak!
achievement.13.description: Siz iste'dodli savdogarsiz, u mahsulotlarga ehtiyotkorlik bilan munosabatda bo'lasiz, yaxshi takliflarni topasiz va vaqti-vaqti bilan noyob narsalarni topasiz. Buyurtmani bajarish uchun hech qachon kechikmang, siz ishonchli savdogarsiz - hech bo'lmaganda Rashidning nazarida.
achievement.13.name: Taniqli savdogar
achievement.14.description: Hayot bulog‘idan topib, bir ho‘plading. Bu sizga abadiy hayot bermadi deb o'yladim, o'zingizni o'zgargan va qandaydir xotirjam his qilasiz.
achievement.14.name: Hayot favvorasi
achievement.15.description: Siz elementar sferalarning syurreal olami bo'ylab sayohat qildingiz, neytral materiyani olish uchun elementlarning Rabbini chaqirdingiz va o'ldirdingiz. Qanchalik jasur bo'lsangiz ham, jamoangizsiz buni uddalay olmas edingiz!
achievement.15.name: Elementlarning Rabbi
achievement.16.description: Siz plyajda “Shrewni qo‘llab-quvvatlash” filmini qaytadan namoyish qildingiz va injiq qizlarni yaxshi boshqarishingiz mumkinligini isbotladingiz. Baliq dumi bilan yoki bo'lmasdan.
achievement.16.name: Plyaj Tamer
achievement.17.description: Agar biror narsa qilsangiz, uni to'g'ri qilasiz. Sizning fikringiz bor va siz uni qo'llab-quvvatlaysiz - va hech kim sizni boshqa yo'l bilan ishontira olmaydi. Bir tomondan, siz shafqatsiz va urushga yo'naltirilgan tomondasiz, lekin bu yomon emas, shunday emasmi?
achievement.17.name: Azerusning izdoshi
achievement.18.description: Siz tinchlikparvarsiz va kichik odamlar nima deyishini tinglang. Siz qaror qildingiz va kimga va qanday sabablarga ko'ra yordam berishni bildingiz - va buni izchil bajarasiz. Sizning urushingiz qurol bilan emas, balki aql bilan olib boriladi.
achievement.18.name: Palimutning izdoshi
achievement.19.description: Sizga taklif qilingan ov sinovi uchun har qanday imkoniyatdan sakrab chiqasiz va bu vazifalarni o'lik aniqlik bilan bajarasiz. Siz chin yurakdan ovchisiz va Paw & Fur jamiyatining qimmatli a'zosisiz.
achievement.19.name: Elita Hunter
achievement.20.description: Siz ov vazifalari bilan tanishsiz va allaqachon bir nechtasini bajargansiz. Oldinda Paw & Fur jamiyati uchun ovchi sifatida yorqin martaba kutmoqda!
achievement.20.name: Huntsman
achievement.21.description: Siz uchun o'pish oddiy lablarga teginishdan ko'ra ko'proq narsadir. Siz qizlarni ham, o'liklarni ham tengsiz mehr bilan o'pasiz va banshi malikasining o'pishi orqali o'lim va qayta tug'ilishga duch kelasiz. Siz bilan shunday samimiy daqiqalarni baham ko'rganlar baxtlidir!
achievement.21.name: Ehtirosli Kisser
achievement.22.description: Siz o'zingizni "oila" ning munosib a'zosi sifatida isbotladingiz va Venoreya savdogarlari va ularning maqsadlarini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun "amaki" uchun ko'plab josuslik missiyalarini muvaffaqiyatli bajardingiz.
achievement.22.name: Eng yaxshi AVIN agenti
achievement.23.description: Qizning kuchi! Siz ayolmisiz yoki yo'qmi, siz mutlaqo sodiqligingizni va Karlin qizlar brigadasi uchun hayotingizni xavf ostiga qo'yishga tayyor ekanligingizni isbotladingiz.
achievement.23.name: Eng yaxshi CGB agenti
achievement.24.description: Fitna va ochiq sirlar sizning kundalik noningizdir. Dushmanlar bilan to'qnash kelish va josuslik missiyalarini bajarishda jasoratingiz orqali Tailand tojiga sodiqligingizni ko'rsatdingiz. Siz TBIning ajoyib dala agentisiz.
achievement.24.name: Eng yaxshi TBI agenti
achievement.25.description: Ayg'oqchi jihozlaringizni to'plang va maxfiy agentlik xizmatidagi xavfli missiyalarga tayyorlaning. Siz buni xohlayotganingizni ko'rsatdingiz - lekin buni qila olasizmi? Vaqt ko'rsatadi.
achievement.25.name: Maxfiy agent
achievement.26.description: Siz intiluvchan mago-mexaniksiz. Ilm-fan va sehr sizning ko'z o'ngingizda yaxshi ishlaydi - va siz Telasda ishlayotganingizda son-sanoqsiz noto'g'ri ayblovlarni topshirgan bo'lsangiz ham, hozir o'z golemingizni yaratish uchun etarli bilimga ega bo'lishingiz mumkin.
achievement.26.name: Gears ichida Golem
achievement.27.description: Siz ko'p marta aytgan she'rlar, she'rlar, qo'shiqlar va qofiyalar. Siz sirli eshikdan o'tdingiz, qadimiy ilmlarning raconteori. Siz hatto elflarni ham hayratda qoldirgansiz, shuning uchun siz haqiqatan ham barakali ekansiz.
achievement.27.name: Shoir mukofoti laureati
achievement.28.description: Sizga berilgan har qanday musiqa asbobini boshqarishingiz mumkin va u bilan yoqimli ovoz chiqarishga muvaffaq bo'lasiz. Siz ko'pchilik tavernalarda xush kelibsiz mehmon va tomoshabinsiz.
achievement.28.name: Minstrel
achievement.29.description: Siz Banutani besh qo'lingizdek bilasiz va qutilar va idishlarni yo'q qilishni yaxshi bilasiz. Ulkan oyoq izlarini ko'rish ham sizni noma'lum joylarni o'rganishga xalaqit bermaydi.
achievement.29.name: Maymunlarning do'sti
achievement.30.description: Sizning xaritangiz sizning do'stingiz - har doim orqa cho'ntagingizda va qiziqarli va foydali joylarning son-sanoqsiz belgilari bilan qoplangan. Aytish mumkinki, siz usiz yo'qolib ketishingiz mumkin - lekin baxtga uni sizdan tortib olishning iloji yo'q.
achievement.30.name: Hududiy
achievement.31.description: Siz Marid uchun qimmatli ittifoqchi ekanligingizni isbotladingiz va Gabel hohlagan vaqtda Xorun va Nah'Bob bilan savdo qilishingizni mamnuniyat bilan qabul qildi. Jinlar urushi hali ham tugamagan bo'lsa-da, Marid siz bilan ular tomonda muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramaydi.
achievement.31.name: Marid Ally
achievement.32.description: Garchi Efreet sizni noilojlik bilan kutib oldi va sizni ancha vaqt davomida "faqat inson" sifatida ko'rgan bo'lsa ham, siz Malorni hayratda qoldirdingiz va uning hurmatini qozondingiz va yashil jinlar bilan savdo qilish imkoniyatiga ega bo'ldingiz.
achievement.32.name: Efreet Ally
achievement.33.description: Orzular - sizning haqiqatingizmi? G'alati vahiylar, soatlarning taqillatilishi, uxlash va butunlay boshqa joyda uyg'onish - bu qandaydir sayohat edi, lekin siz haqiqatan ham undan zavqlanganingizga deyarli aminmiz.
achievement.33.name: Aniq tush ko'ruvchi
achievement.34.description: Ko‘pchilik hatto nomini ham bilmaydigan joylarda bo‘lgansiz. Botanika, zoologik va ektoplazmatik namunalarni yig'ish sizning kundalik ishingiz bo'lib, siz doimo yangi ufqlarni kashf etishga tayyormiz.
achievement.34.name: Explorer
achievement.35.description: Hatto dushman suv osti muhiti ham Explorer jamiyati oldidagi burchingizni bajarishingizga xalaqit bermaydi. Quara shohligini skaut qilish siz uchun pirojnoe bo'lagidir.
achievement.35.name: Dengiz skauti
achievement.36.description: Voy - bu nima edi? Siz bu erga qanday kelganingizni bilmaysiz, lekin qandaydir tarzda keldingiz. Beregardan Kazordoonga bir zumda qanday borish mumkin - bu mittilar bilishni yaxshi ko'radigan narsa, lekin siz uni qanday ko'paytirishni bilmayapsiz.
achievement.36.name: Pathfinder dargumon
achievement.37.description: Issiq, mo'ynali va xushchaqchaq - siz quchoqlagan o'sha ayiq hushida bo'lganida sizni parchalab tashlagan bo'lsa-da, u sizga hali kichkinaligingizda to'shagingizda doimo uxlab yotgan keksa ayiqchani eslatdi.
achievement.37.name: Bearhugger
achievement.38.description: Siz ularni ovlamaysiz, ular bilan gaplashasiz. Bilasizmi, arvohlar uzoq vaqtdan beri tiriklar orasida yo'qolgan sirlarni saqlashi mumkin va siz ularni sizga oshkor qilish uchun gapirishga mohirsiz.
achievement.38.name: Ghostwhisperer
achievement.39.description: Kichkina, zaif hayvonlarga nisbatan yumshoq joyingiz bor va siz ularni himoya qilish uchun qo'lingizdan kelganini qilasiz - hatto nonushta uchun ajdarlarni iste'mol qilsangiz ham.
achievement.39.name: Hayvonlar faoli
achievement.40.description: Siz ayiqlarni quchoqladingiz, mamontlarni itarib yubordingiz va ichish qobiliyatingizni isbotladingiz. Sizda ozgina osilib qolgan, qovurg'angiz qisman singan va tilingizda bir oz yog'li sochlar bo'lsa ham, siz bundan buyon o'zingizni faxriy vahshiy deb atashdan juda faxrlanasiz.
achievement.40.name: Faxriy barbar
achievement.41.description: Siz bu erda savollarni qo'yadigan odamsiz va siz eshitishni xohlagan javoblarni qanday olishni bilasiz. Qolaversa, siz mashhur exorcistsiz va u erda va u erda bir nechta vampir va jinlarni o'ldirasiz. Siz va sizning ulushingiz mukammal jamoasiz.
achievement.41.name: Oliy inkvizitor
achievement.42.description: Veee! Bu qurtlarni uring! Katta bolg'ani qanday boshqarishni bilasiz.
achievement.42.name: Worm Whacker
achievement.43.description: Siz bu nima ekanligini bilmayapsiz, lekin o'zingizni qirollikka jalb qilgandek his qilasiz. Taxtlar oldida emaklab yurishdan tizzalaringiz har doim bir oz o'tlanadi va siz qal'alarda osilganlarni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Ehtimol, siz qo'riqchi sifatida murojaat qilishni o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerakmi?
achievement.43.name: Qirol Tibianus Fan
achievement.44.description: Siz tez yuguruvchisiz va hech qanday transport vositasidan foydalana olmasangiz yoki qo'llaringiz sovib qolsa ham, vaqt o'tishi bilan chirishi mumkin bo'lgan mahsulotlarni yetkazib berishni yaxshi bilasiz.
achievement.44.name: Aynan o'z vaqtida
achievement.45.description: Siz boshqalarga hazil o'ynashni va ularni aldashni biroz ahmoqona ko'rinishga keltirishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Qimirlagan tillar sizning qurbonlaringizning ko'z o'ngida anglash lahzasi siz oziqlanadigan mukofot ekanligini aytishadi, lekin siz shunchaki hazillashayotgandirsiz va ular bilan zavqlanasiz ... to'g'rimi?
achievement.45.name: Perfect Fool
achievement.46.description: Ba'zan hayotning eng katta sirlari oddiy yechimga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.46.name: Mathemagician
achievement.47.description: Maktublar va posilkalarni yetkazib berish har doim sizning sirli ishtiyoqingiz bo'lib kelgan va endi siz rasmiy ravishda ko'k shlyapangizni kiyishingiz, pochta shoxingizni chalishingiz va o'zingiz yoqtirgan narsani qilishingiz mumkin. Itlardan ehtiyot bo'ling!
achievement.47.name: Archpostman
achievement.48.description: Romantikaning tasodif ekanligiga yoki bir qarashda oshiq bo‘lishiga ishonmaysiz. Aslida - sevgi choylari, guldastalar va shirin she'rlar har qachongidan ham yaxshiroq hiyla qiladi. Bu gormonlar oqimini saqlang!
achievement.48.name: Matchmaker
achievement.49.description: Siz Armenius o'zining haqiqiy qiyofasini ko'rsatishni tanlagan kam sonli tibiyaliklardansiz va u sizni u bilan jang qilishga majburlagan. Yoki bu sizning juda omadli yoki juda omadsiz ekanligingizni anglatadi, lekin bir narsa aniq - bu juda kam.
achievement.49.name: Uning haqiqiy yuzi
achievement.50.description: O'tkir it tishlari bo'lgan odamlar sizdan ehtiyot bo'lishlari kerak, ayniqsa kechasi, yoki ular qovurg'alari orasidan qoziq topishlari mumkin. Siz shafqatsiz vampir ovchisisiz va dalil sifatida ko'plab tokenlarni to'plagansiz.
achievement.50.name: Razing!
achievement.51.description: O‘g‘irlik, o‘zingizni VIP-ziyofatlarga taklif qilish, kontraktlarni soxtalashtirish va o‘zingizni boshqa birovdek ko‘rsatish – siz noqonuniy harakatlarga kelganda, barcha savdo-sotiqlarning shaydosisiz. Vaqti-vaqti bilan oltin baliqlarni hisobga olmaganda, siz hech qanday asir olmaysiz.
achievement.51.name: Usta o'g'ri
achievement.52.description: Siz Princess Buttercup, Doctor Dumbness va Lucky the Wonder Dogni jonlantirishga yordam berdingiz - va ehtimol bugun kechqurun ularni orzu qilasiz, chunki siz satrlaringizni mukammal yodlagansiz. Qanday .. maxsus parcha.. ssenariy.
achievement.52.name: Havaskor aktyor
achievement.53.description: Siz Svargrond maydonida Olov Ruhining alangasini o'chirdingiz. Arena janglari siz uchun - adolatli, kvadrat, oddiy qoidalar va yakkama-yakka janglar.
achievement.53.name: Scrapper
achievement.54.description: Siz Svargrond arenasida Zolim Orkusni yo'q qildingiz. Siz hali ham quloqlar orqasida bir oz yashilsiz, lekin bu erda katta imkoniyatlar mavjud.
achievement.54.name: Greenhorn
achievement.55.description: Siz Obliveratorni Svargrond arenasida unutib yubordingiz va yo'lda yana to'qqizta xavfli dushmanni mag'lub qildingiz. Svargrond sardori barchaga salom!
achievement.55.name: Svargrond sardori
achievement.56.description: Siz sirli iblis eman va u sizning yuzingizga tashlagan barcha jonivorlarga duch keladigan va ularni engish uchun jasur qahramonlardan birisiz. Muborak boltangizni ushlaganingizda, hech qanday daraxt yo'lingizga to'sqinlik qila olmaydi - iblismi yoki yo'q.
achievement.56.name: Herbicide
achievement.57.description: Siz jasorat bilan mashhur Annihilatorga sakrab tushdingiz va omon qoldingiz - shon-shuhrat, shon-sharaf va mukofotingizni olib.
achievement.57.name: Annihilator
achievement.58.description: Siz Demon Forgedagi son-sanoqsiz qo'shinlar orasidan o'tib jang qila oldingiz. Hech narsa imkonsiz emasligini yana bir bor isbotladingiz.
achievement.58.name: Nexus ustasi
achievement.59.description: Siz raqsning xo'jayini yoki xonimisiz - va qabila xudolarini hayratda qoldirish uchun o'z mahoratingizni ishlatishdan qo'rqmaysiz. Chapga bir qadam, o'ngga bir sakrash, burish va baqir!
achievement.59.name: Iqtidorli raqqosa
achievement.60.description: Mutlaqo zararsiz tabassum bilan siz barcha kulgili yigitlarni aldab, portlagan kukilaringizni yeyishga majbur qildingiz. Keyingi safar bu hazilni tortib olsangiz, uni yanada yaxshiroq qilish uchun Boy Scout libosini kiyishni o'ylab ko'ring.
achievement.60.name: Cookie-fayllarga ruxsat berilsinmi?
achievement.61.description: Siz Shafqatsiz Yettilikning barcha taxtlariga tegib, ularning yovuz ruhini singdirdingiz. Bu sizni abadiy o'zgartirgan bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.61.name: Shafqatsiz
achievement.62.description: Siz janjal orolida shafqatsiz 2 va 2 jamoaviy turnirda g'alaba qozondingiz va dahshatli raqiblar to'lqinini yo'q qildingiz. O'lim yoki g'alaba - siz, albatta, ikkinchisini tanladingiz.
achievement.62.name: Chazorai chempioni
achievement.63.name: Wayfarer
achievement.64.description: Bir narsa aniq: siz suzishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Do'stlaringiz bilan sohilda dam olish, muzqaymoq yeyish va plyajda to'p o'ynash juda qiziqarli!
achievement.64.name: Waverider
achievement.65.description: Musiqa sizga tabiiy ravishda keladi. Siz har qanday sahnada, istalgan vaqtda o'zingizni qulay his qilasiz va qachondir faqat musiqa chalish orqali dushmanlaringizni mag'lub eta olishingizga yashirincha umid qilasiz. Harakat qiling!
achievement.65.name: Rockstar
achievement.66.description: Pul olish haqida gap ketganda, albatta sizning yo'llaringiz bor. Ularning ko'pchiligi pushti va chinni singan parchalari bilan qoplangan.
achievement.66.name: Nafaqa yig'uvchi
achievement.67.description: Sochingizdagi shabada, barmoqlaringiz gilamingizning chetini mahkam ushlab turishi - siz sayohat qilishni shunday yoqtirasiz. Tezroq! Yuqoriroq! Va vaqti-vaqti bilan loop.
achievement.67.name: Yuqori uchuvchi
achievement.68.description: Siz qo'llaringizni ho'llashni va iflos qilishni yaxshi ko'rasiz - va loy bilan qoplangan. Sizning mukammal Brog haykalingiz, g'azablangan Titan sizning haqiqiy asaringizdir.
achievement.68.name: Clay Fighter
achievement.69.description: Ehtimol, endi siz qanday ko'rinishga ega ekanligingizni bilmaysiz - odatda oynaga qaraganingizda, qandaydir yirtqich hayvon sizga tikiladi. Boshqa tomondan - ehtimol bu yaxshilanishdir?
achievement.69.name: Masquerader
achievement.70.description: Dengiz ostida - bu sizning tabiiy yashash joyingiz bo'lmasligi mumkin, ammo okean tubida o'zingizni juda qulay his qilyapsiz. Quara endi sizni qo'rqitmaydi va ba'zida siz hali ham jihozlangan dubulg'a bilan uxlaysiz.
achievement.70.name: Chuqur dengiz sho'ng'idi
achievement.71.description: Yalang oyoq cho'g' bo'ylab yugurish siz uchun emas! Siz buni oqlangan tarzda qilasiz. Shunday bo'lsa-da, siz olovga va umuman issiq muhitga qiziqasiz - sizga issiq yoqadi!
achievement.71.name: Firewalker
achievement.72.description: Oh, dengiz hidi! Sohilda turish va chiziq chizish sizning sevimli mashg'ulotlaringizdan biridir. Siz uchun baliq ovlash dam olish va shu bilan birga oson ovqat bilan ta'minlashdir. Mukammal!
achievement.72.name: Mana, Fishy Fishy!
achievement.73.description: Agar kimdir sizga urug' bersa, siz odatda bir necha kun ichida undan chiroyli o'simlik o'stirasiz. Sizga yashil va gullar bilan bezatilgan uyingiz yoqadi. Ehtimol, siz ham ular bilan gaplashasiz.
achievement.73.name: Yashil bosh barmog'i
achievement.74.description: Mahalliy sehrgaringiz sizni o'zining eng yaxshi mijozlaridan biri deb biladi - siz tunning o'rtasida uyg'onib, ko'proq narsani xohlamasligingiz uchun odatda katta miqdorda iksirlar sotib olasiz. Shunga qaramay, siz har doim ulardan juda tez tugaydiganga o'xshaysiz. Salom!
achievement.74.name: Iksirga qaram
achievement.75.description: Siz sovuq muhitda dam olishni yaxshi ko'rasiz va muzni shakllantirish uchun eng yaxshi material deb hisoblaysiz. Undan chiroyli mamont haykalini yaratishingiz mumkin bo'lsa, ichimliklar uchun muz kublarini ishlatish naqadar isrof!
achievement.75.name: Muz haykaltaroshi
achievement.76.description: Sizning uyingiz sizning qal'angiz - va undagi mebel ham xuddi shunday muhim. Sizning do'stlaringiz o'z uylarini bezashda sizdan maslahat so'rashadi va u erda har bir haykal, tokcha va to'shakda bo'lishingiz mumkin.
achievement.76.name: Ichki dekorator
achievement.77.description: Ba'zida siz u erda gremlin borligini his qilasiz. Shuncha lotereya chiptalari, shuncha blankalar? Bu adolatdan emas! O'z qayg'ularingizni dunyo bilan baham ko'ring.
achievement.77.name: Jinx
achievement.78.description: Bu bir kishi uchun juda ko'p omad. Agar biror narsa haqiqatan ham juda kamdan-kam hollarda bo'lsa - u ertami-kechmi quchog'ingizga tushadi. Tabriklaymiz!
achievement.78.name: Baxtli Iblis
achievement.79.description: Siz marmar haykaltarosh bo'lib, istiqbolli mahoratga egasiz - bu siz yaratgan mukammal kichkina Tibiasula haykali bilan tasdiqlangan. Bir kun kelib siz haqiqatan ham mashhur bo'lasiz!
achievement.79.name: Marblelous
achievement.80.description: Ey xudoyim, bu paaaaaaaaaaaarty! Siz har doim o'yin-kulgiga tayyorsiz, do'stlar va spirtli ichimliklar va sevgi diqqat markazida. Bayramni nishonlash uchun cheksiz sabablar bor! Voy!
achievement.80.name: Partiya hayvoni
achievement.81.description: Raketangiz uchib, go‘zal ranglarda portlashdan oldingi lahzani yaxshi ko‘rasiz - nafaqat yangi yil arafasida!
achievement.81.name: Osmonda otashinlar
achievement.82.description: Toshbaqaning orqa tomonida sayohat qilishdan ko'ra... bor... oddiygina... yo'q... yaxshiroq... yo'l. Hech bo'lmaganda siz Lagunaning go'zal muhitidan bahramand bo'lasiz.
achievement.82.name: Toshbaqa kabi tez
achievement.83.description: Agar zanglagan buyumni ko'rsangiz, uni sayqallashga qarshi tura olmaysiz. Sizning inventaringizda har doim bir oz zangni tozalash vositasi bor - kim biladi, bu axloqsizlik ostida oltin zirh bordir!
achievement.83.name: Jilo
achievement.84.description: Ehtimol, hayotingizda hech qachon dengiz kasaliga duchor bo'lmagansiz - siz bo'sh vaqtingizni okeanda o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'rasiz va kemalar bilan juda ko'p kilometrlarni bosib o'tasiz. Bularning hammasini suzishga majbur bo'lmaganingizdan xursand emasmisiz?
achievement.84.name: Kobold kemasi
achievement.85.description: Er osti daryolari bo'ylab mitti qayiqlar bilan sayohat qilish - bu yerlarni kesib o'tishning afzal ko'rgan usuli. Hech qanday asabiy chayqalar yo'q va bortda yaxshi pivo!
achievement.85.name: Steampunked
achievement.86.description: Siz shunchaki mukammal, ajoyib, go'zal ajoyib emasmisiz? Tashqi ko'rinishingizga qoyil qolmasdan ko'zgudan o'tib bo'lmaydi. Yoki tishlaringizga biror narsa yopishib qolgan-qilmaganligini tezda tekshirib ko'ryapsizmi?
achievement.86.name: Bekorchilik
achievement.87.description: Folbinlar va munajjimlar bashorati sizni hayotingiz davomida boshqaradi. Va, ehtimol, sizning ishonchli vudu bosh suyagi sizga kun uchun roziligini bermasdan, katta o'yin oviga borishga jur'at eta olmas edingiz.
achievement.87.name: Xurofot
achievement.88.description: Siz Yalaharga xizmat qildingiz - lekin yo'lda kimga ishonishni unchalik aniq bilmas edingiz. Azerusning ham, Palimutning ham xatti-harakatlari uchun jiddiy sabablar bor edi va shuning uchun siz ulardan biriga yordam bergan bo'lsangiz ham, oxir-oqibat o'z instinktingizga ergashdingiz. Yalaxar obod bo'lsin!
achievement.88.name: Turncoat
achievement.89.description: Sizning kichkina Tibiasula haykallaringiz Tibia atrofida juda mashhur bo'lib ketdi va marmarni shakllantirishda shunga o'xshash mahoratga ega odamlar kam.
achievement.89.name: Marmar jinniligi
achievement.90.description: G'azablangan Titan Brogni haykaltaroshlik qilish sizning sirli ishtiyoqingizdir. Sizning ismingiz yozilgan ko'plab mukammal kichkina loy haykallarni Tibia atrofida hamma joyda topish mumkin.
achievement.90.name: Clay to Fame
achievement.91.description: Muz kubini va obsidian pichog'ini oling va siz undan juda chiroyli narsalarni shakllantirasiz. Ko'pincha yoqimli kichkina mamontlar, bu barcha qizlarni hayratda qoldiradi.
achievement.91.name: Muz kabi sovuq
achievement.92.description: Siz baliqni yaxshi ko'rasiz - lekin yaxshisi sovuq shimolda tutilgan. Ularning oldiga kelish qiyin bo'lsa ham, siz muzliklarni teshiklarni terib, tayog'ingizni osib qo'yishdan hech qachon charchamaysiz.
achievement.92.name: Ajoyib ta'm
achievement.93.description: Irqlararo tushunish haqida gap ketganda, siz mutaxassissiz. Siz Chakoya tilini yaxshi bildingiz va saxiyligingiz bilan kimnidir xursand qildingiz. Ochuq!
achievement.93.name: Jamjam
achievement.94.description: Sizning dunyongiz sizga borligidan baxtiyor! Dunyoni qutqarish uchun jasur qahramonlar chaqirilganda, siz sakrab yordam berishdan tortinmaysiz.
achievement.94.name: Men o'z qismimni qildim
achievement.95.description: Dunyongizni qutqarish yoki ijtimoiy tadbirlarda ishtirok etish haqida gap ketganda, siz oldingi qatordasiz. Siz buni odamlar tomonidan e'tiborga olingan yoki sezdirmasdan qilsangiz ham, sizning dunyongiz uni hamma uchun yaxshiroq joyga aylantirish uchun o'z burchingizni bajarishingizga tayanishi mumkin.
achievement.95.name: Mashhur Worldsaver
achievement.96.description: Boshqa birov Devovorgani o'ldirgani uchun g'alaba qozonishi mumkin bo'lsa, siz o'zingizni iflos ishlarni qilish uchun juda yaxshi deb hisoblamaysiz. Sizsiz ular buni qila olmadilar!
achievement.96.name: Jamoa o'yinchisi
achievement.97.description: Siz Devovorga iniga kirdingiz va uni tushirishga urinayotgan ekipajga qo'shildingiz - muvaffaqiyat toji kiyganmi yoki yo'qmi, muhim emas, lekin ular sizni sinab ko'rmaganingiz uchun ayblay olmaydi!
achievement.97.name: Jasoratli buzg'unchi
achievement.98.description: Ruhlar kapalaklarga o'xshaydi. Oyog'ingiz ostida zarba berishni orzu qilgan tirik qurolning qora ruhi yotadi.
achievement.98.name: Anmotra qotili
achievement.99.description: Qudrat unga buyruq bergan ayolning irodasiga bog'liq. Siz to'liq kuch bilan kurashdingiz - va kuchliroq bo'ldingiz.
achievement.99.name: Chikhaton qotili
achievement.100.description: Tuzoqqa tushib qolgan va yirtilgan jonzotning vahshiy g'azabiga kam narsa tengdir. Siz munosib raqib bo'ldingiz.
achievement.100.name: Irahsaning qotili
achievement.101.description: Ko'r-ko'rona nafrat jismoniy shaklga ega bo'lib, u tug'ilgan adolatsizlikka qarshi zo'ravonlik bilan isyon ko'rsatdi. Siz adolat keltira olmadingiz - lekin hech bo'lmaganda vaqtinchalik tinchlik.
achievement.101.name: Frodomo qotili
achievement.102.description: Aeonlarning taqiqlangan bilimlari hech qachon bu dunyoni bosib olish uchun mo'ljallanmagan. Siz uning ovozini eshitmasdan oldin o'chirdingiz.
achievement.102.name: Teneshpar qotili
achievement.103.description: Siz Devovorganing xavfli chodirlarini va uning katta pillasini tushirishga yordam berdingiz - uning o'zgarishini to'xtatmasdan, oxir-oqibat uning o'limi uchun muhim qadamni yakunladingiz.
achievement.103.name: Qiyomat pillasi
achievement.104.description: Ko'pchilik orasida alohida qahramon. Bu yil - bu siz edingiz. Devovorga sizning va o'rtoqlaringizning kuchiga dosh bera olmagani uchun qorong'i dunyoga chekindi. Sizning tanlovingiz to'g'ri yoki yo'qligini vaqt ko'rsatadi, ammo hozircha u sizning dunyongizni saqlab qoldi.
achievement.104.name: Devovorga's Nemesis
achievement.105.description: Charchagan... juda charchagan... issiq va shinam to'shakda jingalak bo'lish hozir eng zo'r narsaga o'xshaydi. Shirin tushlar!
achievement.105.name: Mister Sandman
achievement.106.description: Uxlash - siz buni uslub bilan qilasiz. Hamakda sovqotib, qushlar va chigirtkalarning ovoziga quloq solib, asta-sekin orzular olamiga borasan.
achievement.106.name: Meni uyquga silkit
achievement.107.description: Qulay uxlash uchun sizga ko'p narsa kerak emas. Bir dasta somon va boshingizga tom yopish - bu butunlay ixtiyoriy - dam olish uchun etarli. Kalamushlarning oyoq barmoqlarini tishlashiga ham qarshi emassiz.
achievement.107.name: Kamtar mehmon
achievement.108.description: Xo'sh, bu sovg'aning mazmuni siz kutgandek emas edi. Bunday do'stlar bilan kimga dushman kerak?
achievement.108.name: Sizda hazil
achievement.109.description: Sizning tukli do'stingiz uchun juda ko'p! Balki qush qafasi oldida turib, uning bo‘ynini qisib, “Qo‘shiq ayt! Qo'shiq ayt! Qo‘shiq ayting!” buning uchun bir oz ko'p edi ?!
achievement.109.name: Voy
achievement.110.description: Siz ovchilar va terimchilar hayotini yashaysiz. Xo'sh, ayniqsa, terimchi va ayniqsa, ko'p ko'k mevalarni yig'adigan kishi. Yaqinda tilingiz rangini tekshirdingizmi?
achievement.110.name: Bluebarian
achievement.111.description: Qalin, qizil - chayqalgan, aralashtirilmagan - va unda somon bilan: bu sizning jin qoningizni afzal ko'rgan yo'l. Piyoz halqasi bilan xizmat qilganda, nozik metall ta'mi deyarli sezilmaydi. Salomatlik yoki mana uchun foydali ta'sirlar mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadi.
achievement.111.name: Demonik Barkeeper
achievement.112.description: Siz qishni yaxshi ko'rasiz. Sharf va qo'lqoplar bilan to'liq jihozlangan, siz do'stlaringiz bilan ko'plab qordan odamlarni qurishda tashqarida dam olishni yoqtirasiz. Qor to'pi bilan kurash, kimdir?
achievement.112.name: Qordan odam
achievement.113.name: Hayvonning soni
achievement.114.description: Siz va to'ldirilgan mo'ynali do'stlaringiz ajralmassiz va ularni o'zingiz bilan to'shakka olib borishdan uyalmaysiz - kim biladi, qachon tun yarmida quchoqqa muhtoj bo'lib uyg'onasiz?
achievement.114.name: Meni quchoqlang
achievement.115.description: Mayli, tan olaylik, agar u sizni eng katta xazinaga olib borishi mumkinligiga ishonsangiz, u qanchalik baliqli ko'rinmasin, bu xaritani qo'yib yubormaysiz. Bularning barchasi zamirida qandaydir sir bo'lsa kerak!
achievement.115.name: Engil imkoniyat
achievement.116.description: Yoki siz tez o'rganuvchi emassiz yoki o'zingizga o't qo'yishdan zavqlanasiz. Yoki siz shunchaki chiroyli sarlavha qidiryapsiz. Qanday bo'lmasin, shuni bilishingiz kerakki, kichik eshak tajribalari paytida gaz o'tkazish tavsiya etilmaydi.
achievement.116.name: Cho'ntakdagi raketa
achievement.117.description: Lekin ko'zingizni yuming va hech kimga nima orzu qilganingizni aytmang, aks holda u amalga oshmaydi!
achievement.117.name: Tilagingizni tilang
achievement.118.description: Rojdestvo - bu yilning eng sevimli vaqti va bola, siz sovg'alarni yaxshi ko'rasizmi? Do'stlaringiz uchun yoqimli narsalarni sotib oling, ularni o'zingiz ochishga qaror qilguningizcha yashiring.
achievement.118.name: Santaning Li'l yordamchisi
achievement.119.description: Zararli spawnning g'azabi - siz tasodifan unga duchor bo'ldingiz. Sizning kunlaringiz sanaladi va o'limingiz muqarrar. Vaqti-vaqti bilan. Bir joyda.
achievement.119.name: Cursed!
achievement.120.description: Vajjaj! Topuvchilar qo'riqchilar, yutqazganlar yig'laydilar! Bularning hammasi qayerdan kelgani va uni olish uchun axlat uyumlarini aylanib o'tishga to'g'ri kelsa, kimga qiziq? Bu BEPUL!
achievement.120.name: Bepul mahsulotlar!
achievement.121.description: Yuqoriga va pastga va yuqoriga va pastga ... va keyin katta halqa! Kutib turing - ular Kazordoonda looplar qurmaydilar. Ammo ma'danli vagonda yurish hali ham qiziqarli!
achievement.121.name: Rollercoaster
achievement.122.description: Siz, ser yoki xonim, haqiqiy alkimyogarsiz. Har bir mumkin bo'lgan kombinatsiyani topish uchun transmutatsion eksperimentlarni o'tkazish ko'p yillar davomida sizning yashirin ishtiyoqingiz bo'lib kelgan va tadqiqotingiz natijalari aql bovar qilmaydi. Siz tufayli ilm-fan sakrashga erishdi!
achievement.122.name: Transmutator
achievement.123.description: RAWR! Tanangizda kuch yuguradi, yuragingiz tezroq yuguradi va har bir qurolingiz tebranishini adrenalin bilan to'ldiradi. Hammasi kichik shishada. Buzilgan mebel uchun pul qaytarib berilmaydi. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.123.name: Berserker
achievement.124.description: Siz eng qiyin topishmoqlarni bir daqiqa ichida hal qilishingiz mumkinligini his qilasiz. Bundan tashqari, afsunga zarar yetkazish uchun yaxshi kuch bor. Hammasi kichik shishada. Keyingi ta'sirlar - biroz ahmoqlik. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.124.name: Boshlovchi
achievement.125.description: Yaxshilangan ko'rish qobiliyati, yorug'lik tezligida uchadigan o'qlar va murvatlar va dushmanlaringizni qo'shimcha zarar bilan bog'lash. Hammasi kichik shishada. Sabzi iste'mol qilish shart emas. Qo'shimcha savollar uchun davolovchi yoki iksir sotuvchisiga murojaat qiling.
achievement.125.name: Sharpshooter
achievement.126.description: Urgh! Derazalarni yoping! Xunuk sarg'ish boshini ko'targan quyoshni o'chiring, qo'shningizning baquvvat bolalarining quloqlarini yirtuvchi kulgilarini yoping. Ahhh. Shirin zulmat va sukunatni quchoqlang.
achievement.126.name: Bezovta qilinmasin
achievement.127.description: Ko'taring va porlang! Bu ajoyib yangi kun - derazalaringizni oching, quyoshning iliq nurini his qiling, derazangizda qushlarning sayrashini tomosha qiling va o'simliklaringizga g'amxo'rlik qiling. Baxtli bo'lmaslik uchun qanday sabab bor?
achievement.127.name: Quyosh nuri kirsin
achievement.128.description: Argh! Hozir emas! Qanday qilib bu ko'p funktsiyali asboblardan sharbat siqish kabi arzimas narsa uchun foydalansangiz, hech qachon ishlamay qoladi, lekin sizni quvib kelayotgan olovli ajdaho bilan arqonga ko'tarilishingiz kerak bo'lganda, chalkash bo'ladi?
achievement.128.name: Yomon vaqt
achievement.129.description: Siz baland o'tlarda yoki shoshqaloq yog'ochda qolib ketgan tayyorlanmagan sarguzashtchilarga kulasiz. Yoki siz haqiqatan ham ularga yordam berasiz. Ular sizni... “Machete” deyishadi.
achievement.129.name: Meni hech narsa to'xtata olmaydi
achievement.130.description: O‘roq yelkangizdan o‘tdi, yelkangizda quyosh yondi – siz dehqonsiz va dalada ishlashni yaxshi ko‘rasiz. Yoki yana, ehtimol siz hamkasblaringizni qo'rqitish uchun shunchaki ajoyib ekin doiralarini yaratasiz.
achievement.130.name: Baxtli fermer
achievement.131.description: Ozodlik ko‘rfazi siz uchun eng zo‘r dam olish maskani bo‘lib, shakarqamish yig‘ish bo‘sh vaqtni o‘tkazish uchun juda qulaydir. Shakaringiz bilan choy ichmoqchimisiz, jonim?
achievement.131.name: Tabiiy tatlandırıcı
achievement.132.description: Yo-ho-ho va bir shisha rom - uyda pishirilgan, albatta, qo'lda terilgan va shaxsan o'rim-yig'im qilingan shakarqamish o'simliklaridan tayyorlanadi. Endi, uni eman bochkasida qaritib qo'ying va taxminan 10 yil ichida undan zavqlaning. Yoki sabrsizlar uchun: Keling, hozir paaaarty qilaylik!
achievement.132.name: Homebrewed
achievement.133.description: Cho'lning qumtepalari ostida yashirin xazinalar - ularni topish uchun burningiz bor va siz qaerda qazishni bilasiz. Ular sizni iflos qilib boy qilmasligi mumkin, lekin baribir ular yorqin va chiroyli.
achievement.133.name: Oltin qazuvchi
achievement.134.description: Siz va sizning belkurak - osmonda qilingan gugurt. Yoki jahannam, buning uchun. Har qanday holatda ham pastda. Sizni tosh qoziqlar sehrli tarzda o'ziga jalb qiladi va ularni ochishni va bu teshiklar sizni qayerga olib borishini ko'rishni yaxshi ko'radi. Yaxshi biceps ham.
achievement.134.name: The Undertaker
achievement.135.description: Sizni har kim osonlikcha topishi mumkin, agar ular shunchaki cookie-fayllarni maydalash iziga ergashsa. Siz uchun esa haqiqiy sevgi oxirgi kukini berishni anglatadi.
achievement.135.name: Cookie Monster
achievement.136.description: Va har kim boshqacha da'vo qilsa, yolg'onchidir.
achievement.136.name: Kek - bu haqiqat
achievement.137.description: Mashhur "Eritilgan shokoladli tort" ni siz yozgan bo'lsangiz kerak. Yomg'irli tushdan keyin mo'ri oldida, adyolga o'ralgan holda kakao lazzatlari bilan mashg'ul bo'lish xuddi shunday tuyuladi. Rohatlaning!
achievement.137.name: Shirin tish
achievement.138.description: Sizga yumshoq, mevali bo'laklari va shirin shakarli pirojnoe yoqadi. Va siz ularni o'zingiz qilishni afzal ko'rasiz. Nonvoyxona ochish haqida hech o‘ylab ko‘rganmisiz? Siz hozir juda yaxshi bo'lishingiz kerak!
achievement.138.name: Tepasida olcha bilan
achievement.139.description: Muahahaha bu... mutatsiyaga uchragan qovoq! Uni tushirishga yordam berganingizdan so'ng - siz yordam berdingiz, shunday emasmi? - siz o'z mukofotingizni talab qildingiz va ozmi-ko'pmi g'alati sovg'a oldingiz. Xellouin bayrami bilan!
achievement.139.name: Mutated Presents
achievement.140.description: Nur tashuvchilardan biri. Havzalarning yonib turishiga yordam bergan va zulmatga qarshi birgalikda harakat qilganlardan biri. Olamlar orasidagi yupqa parda ortida jin shivirlaydi - sizning yordamingiz tufayli ular yana jim bo'ldi.
achievement.140.name: Olov qo'riqchisi
achievement.141.description: Siz eng sadoqatli nur tashuvchilardan birisiz - sizsiz jinlar olamlar orasidagi pardani yirtib tashlagan bo'lar edi. Siz har bir havzani yoqib, baland va past sayohat qilib, boshqa dunyo kuchlarini orqaga surdingiz. Nur bo'lsin!
achievement.141.name: Haqiqiy nur tashuvchisi
achievement.142.description: Siz ilon xudosining mujassamlanishini mag'lub qildingiz va ilon tayoqining so'nggi kuchli tebranishi bilan uning hayotiy kuchini to'xtatdingiz. Hokimiyat, hiyla-nayrang va korruptsiya hikoyasi nihoyasiga yetdi - yoki... yo'qmi?
achievement.142.name: Godslayer
achievement.143.description: Uh... yaqinda uyg'ongan odam kim? Yerda singan kokteyl stakanlari, butun xonada gullar va nega uzuk taqqansiz? Kecha uzoq va g'alati kun bo'lsa kerak...
achievement.143.name: Keyingi kun
achievement.144.description: Uzoq muddatli munosabatlar faqat siz uchun emas. Va har safar o'zingizni sevib qolgan deb o'ylaganingizda, ko'p o'tmay noto'g'ri ekanligingiz isbotlangan. Yoki, ehtimol, siz har safar noto'g'ri sevgiliga duch kelishingiz mumkin - ekspluatatsiya qilinadi va xiyonat qiladi. Yolg'iz qolish yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.144.name: Majburiyat fobisi
achievement.145.description: Ishonchi? Sevgimi? Sodiqlikmi? Pah! Qadimgi tuyg'ular. Siz zavqlanar ekansiz, ko'p yuraklarga qadam qo'yishga qarshi emassiz. Tercihen jangovar etik kiyganda.
achievement.145.name: Yurak buzuvchi
achievement.146.description: Yashirin o'ldirish va orqadan pichoqlash sizning mutaxassisligingizdir. Sizning ko'p qurbonlaringiz odatda o'zlarining yaqin o'limlarini bilishmaydi, siz ularga indamay va tez olib kelasiz. Hamma narsaga ruxsat berilgan.
achievement.146.name: Tez o'lim
achievement.147.description: Hayotda eng yaxshisi nima? Dushmanlaringizni yo'q qilish uchun. Ularni sizning oldingizda haydashini ko'rish uchun. Va keyin bir piyola choy ichish uchun.
achievement.147.name: Shafqatsiz xushmuomalalik
achievement.148.description: Siz tilanchisiz, uysiz, harom va yirtiq kiyimdasiz. Ammo bu siz hech kimdan biror narsa so'rashingiz kerak degani emas - va siz hali ham mag'rurligingizni saqlab qolasiz. Yupqa patlar yaxshi qushlarni yaratishi shart emas - ularning ostida nima borligi muhimroqdir.
achievement.148.name: Ko'chalardagi hayot
achievement.149.description: Suyaklar Birodarligining nishonlari va qora liboslarini kiyib, siz qo'rquv va og'riqni tarqatib, yaqinda paydo bo'ladigan nekromantik armiya uchun yangi askarlarni yaratib, erlarni kezasiz. Birodarlikka salom.
achievement.149.name: Bosh suyagi va suyaklari
achievement.150.description: Siz dahshatli tushlardan qo'rqmaysiz, ularda sayohat qilasiz - son-sanoqsiz dahshatlarga duch kelasiz va ular olib keladigan taqdirga qarshi kurashasiz. O'sha tushlaringizdan olib keladigan qorong'u bashoratlaringizga ko'pchilik ishonadi, lekin siz bilan birga Nightmare Knights sifatida kurashadiganlar.
achievement.150.name: Nightmare Walker
achievement.151.description: Har bir shahar sizga o'xshagan odamni o'z aholisi deyishdan faxrlanishi kerak. Siz ko'chalarni toza tutasiz va depo oldidagi odatiy nizolarni hal qilishga yordam berasiz. Bundan tashqari, sizda mushuk bor va piyoda sayr qilishni yoqtirasiz.
achievement.151.name: Namunali fuqaro
achievement.152.description: Siz bu qoziqni faqat bezak uchun olib yurmaysiz - siz undan foydalanishga tayyormiz. Odatda sizni eng chuqur zindonlarda o'ldirilgan jinlar izidan o'tib ketayotganingizni ko'rasiz. Kim sizning yo'lingizda turishga jur'at etsa, o'limga tayyorlansin.
achievement.152.name: Demonbane
achievement.153.description: Biri tabiat bilan, biri yovvoyi tabiat bilan. Xom va hayvoniy kuch, o'tkir hislar, eng baland qoyalarda uvillash va eng qalin o'rmonlarda bo'kirish - bu sizsiz.
achievement.153.name: Bo'rilar va ayiqlar haqida
achievement.154.description: Kunduzi sizni kamuflyajlangan holda o'rmonda tuzoq qo'ygan yoki katta ovni quvgan holda topishingiz mumkin, kechasi siz gulxan yonida o'tirib, ov haqidagi hikoyalaringizni baham ko'rasiz. Ovlaganingni yeb, terisini yeganingni kiyasan. Hayot shunday abadiy davom etishi mumkin edi.
achievement.154.name: Uslub bilan ov qilish
achievement.155.description: Va esda tuting: hech qachon cho'chqaga qo'shiq aytishga o'rgatishga urinmang. Bu sizning vaqtingizni behuda sarflaydi va cho'chqani bezovta qiladi.
achievement.155.name: Yurakdagi ahmoq
achievement.156.description: Kenarli pichoq va mustahkam to'liq plastinka zirh bilan jihozlangan bo'lib, siz dushmanlaringizga kuch va jasorat bilan hujum qilasiz. Siz uchun har doim qutqaradigan qiz va o'ldirish uchun ajdaho bor.
achievement.156.name: Yorqin zirhda
achievement.157.description: Siz kuningizni oltin qozoningizda cho'milishdan boshlaysiz va eng yaxshi kiyimingizda ko'chalarda sayr qilib, boyligingizni ko'rsatishga qarshi emassiz - axir bu sizning mashaqqatli pulingiz! Siz "Janob hazratlari" deb murojaat qilishni afzal ko'rasiz.
achievement.157.name: Aristokrat
achievement.158.description: Qor uyumlari va do‘l sizni bormoqchi bo‘lgan joyingizdan to‘xtata olmaydi. Siz abadiy muzga har qanday ekspeditsiya uchun mukammal jihozlangansiz va oyoqlaringizni qanday isitishni bilasiz. Agar siz ayol bo'lsangiz, bu ham katta muvaffaqiyat.
achievement.158.name: Qor bo'ronida
achievement.159.description: Oyoq barmoqlari orasiga qum tushgan issiq cho‘l quyoshi ostida o‘zingizni uydagidek his qilasiz va sizning sevimli sayohat vositangiz – uchar gilam. Bundan tashqari, siz boshni izolyatsiya qilish raqs harakatini qilishingiz mumkin.
achievement.159.name: Ming bir
achievement.160.description: Ochiq dengizlarda, o'ljalar va qizlar bilan jang qilib, janob bo'ling! Siz hech kimga yoki portlashi mumkin bo'lgan monarxiyaga javob bermang va sizning hayotingiz nilufar jigaridan emas. Ha, do'stim!
achievement.160.name: Swashbuckler
achievement.161.description: Olovni chayqash va o'rmonda baraban chalish uchun olov atrofida raqsga tushish sizga yoqadigan narsaga o'xshaydi. Bundan tashqari, dreadlocks - sochlaringizni kiyishning qulay usuli - tarash shart emas!
achievement.161.name: Shamanning yo'li
achievement.162.description: Siz "Qanday qilib eng zo'r hayvonni jahannam tubidan chaqirish mumkin, I jild" nomli asar muallifi bo'lishingiz mumkin. Yoki, agar sizning fikringiz va qalbingiz toza bo'lsa, siz boshqalarga yordam berish uchun mavjudotlarni chaqirasiz. Yoki quchoqlashi uchun kichkina mushuk bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.162.name: Ritualist
achievement.163.description: Jang qizg'inda o'z ranglaringizni ko'rsatishdan qo'rqmaysiz. Dushmanlar sizning halokatli nayzalaringiz va o'tib bo'lmaydigan zirhlaringizdan qo'rqishadi. Siz g'alaba qozongan urushlar ro'yxati juda ta'sirli. Salom va o'ldir!
achievement.163.name: Urush ustasi
achievement.164.description: Jasorat zaiflar uchundir - jangda qanday g'alaba qozonishingizning ahamiyati yo'q, agar siz g'alaba qozonsangiz. Qalin zirh sizning harakatlaringizga xalaqit beradi, shuning uchun siz uni engil tutasiz va noqulay qobiqda yashirinish o'rniga tezlik va mahoratga tayanasiz.
achievement.164.name: Wild Warrior
achievement.165.description: Siz sayohat va jang qilish uchun boylik yoki maxsus jihozlarga muhtoj bo'lmagan kamtarin jangchisiz. Siz Zaoning shimoliy erlarida o'zingizni uydagidek his qilasiz va uning korruptsiyasiga qarshi kurashda o'z hissangizni qo'shgansiz.
achievement.165.name: Peazzekeeper
achievement.166.description: Yalahar uchun qilgan ishlaringiz odatda chuqur tushuncha va o'ylangan harakatlar bilan ajralib turadi. Siz tufayli Yalahar tinch va baxtli odamlar bilan yashash imkoniyatiga ega bo'lishi mumkin.
achievement.166.name: Hikmat Yalahari
achievement.167.description: Siz Yalaharni shafqatsiz kuch bilan himoya qilasiz va agar kerak bo'lsa, uni shonli jangga olib borishga tayyorsiz. Sizga rahmat, Yalahar har qanday dushmanga qarshi tura oladigan darajada qudratli bo'ladi.
achievement.167.name: Qudrat Yalahari
achievement.168.description: Kerakli vaqtda to'g'ri tort bilan hayot juda oson bo'lishi mumkin - va siz turli xil pishiriqlarni pishirishni o'zlashtirdingiz, shuning uchun hayot sizga tashlashga qaror qilgan deyarli hamma narsaga tayyor bo'lishingiz kerak.
achievement.168.name: Kek bo'lagi
achievement.169.description: Eksperimental sehr va afsunni rivojlantirish sohasidagi kashshof kashfiyotlaringiz va muvaffaqiyatli tadqiqotlaringiz tufayli siz Edrondagi Sehrli akademiyaning birinchi darajali bitiruvchisi hisoblanasiz. Hech qachon Armageddon afsunini o'rgatishni o'ylab ko'rganmisiz?
achievement.169.name: Alumni
achievement.170.description: Siz sehrning qorong'u usullarini yaxshi bilasiz va odatda sham va bosh suyagi ichida o'tirib, so'zlab bo'lmaydigan so'zlarni g'o'ldiradi. Narsalarni juda uzoqqa olib bormang, aks holda jinlar sizni tutishi mumkin.
achievement.170.name: Warlock
achievement.171.description: Haqiqatan ham, sizda quyonlar uchun yumshoq joy bor. Balki bugun qutqargan quyonlaringiz ertaga sizni qutqaradigan quyonlardir. Haqiqatan ham och qolganingizda.
achievement.171.name: Bunny sirg'alib ketdi
achievement.172.description: True scientists know their equipment. Testing new inventions is essential daily work for any hard working researcher. You showed no fear and took all the new equipment from Spectulus and Sinclair for a spin.
achievement.172.name: Guinea Pig
achievement.173.description: You went into the forest, met Rottin Wood and the Married Men and helped them out in their camp. Oh, and don't worry about those merchants. They won't dare mentioning the strangely large sums of gold they actually possessed which are missing now.
achievement.173.name: Merry Adventures
achievement.174.description: You passed their test and helped the Spirithunters testing equipment, researching the supernatural and catching ghosts - it's you they're gonna call.
achievement.174.name: Afraid of no Ghost!
achievement.175.description: Almost all the plants you tested for Chartan in Zao where inedible - you tasted them all, yet you're still standing! You should really get some fresh air now, though.
achievement.175.name: Extreme Degustation
achievement.176.description: You have bravely stepped onto the cake isle. Is there any more beautiful, tasty place to be in the whole world?
achievement.176.name: Cake Conqueror
achievement.177.description: You have cheered up a demon baby and returned it to its mother. A quick count of your fingers will reveal if you made it through unharmed.
achievement.177.name: Baby Sitter
achievement.178.description: You have cheered up a bunch of demon babies and returned them to their mother. Don't bother the burn marks, don't bother the strains of grey hair, don't bother the nights you wake up screaming. It was worth it ... probably ... somehow.
achievement.178.name: Nanny from Hell
achievement.179.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain. Despite the perils, you and your fellow crewmen have braved the challenge.
achievement.179.name: Ghost Sailor
achievement.180.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
achievement.180.name: Spectral Traveller
achievement.181.description: Not fearing death or ghosts you have traveled with the ghost captain several times and are a seasoned traveler of the netherworld. The dead and the living whisper about your exploits with appreciation.
achievement.181.name: Nether Pirate
achievement.182.description: You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
achievement.182.name: Scourge of Death
achievement.183.description: You have helped to keep the witches fire burning. Just watch your fingers, it's hot!
achievement.183.name: Fire Lighter
achievement.184.description: You sacrificed ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches.
achievement.184.name: Witches Lil' Helper
achievement.185.description: You sacrificed a lot of ingredients to create the protective brew of the witches and played a significant part in the efforts to repel the dreaded banebringers. The drawback is that even the banebringers may take notice of you ...
achievement.185.name: Banebringers' Bane
achievement.186.description: To keep the witches' fire burning, you trashed a lot of the wood the bane bringers animated. Some might find your fascination for fire ... disturbing.
achievement.186.name: Fire Devil
achievement.187.description: Love ... fire! So ... shiny! Must ... buuuurrrn!
achievement.187.name: Pyromaniac
achievement.188.description: Your efforts in fighting back the banebringers has not gone unnoticed. You are a legend amongst the witches and your name is whispered with awe and admiration.
achievement.188.name: Honorary Witch
achievement.189.description: Oh, the joy of riding! You've just got your very first own mount. Conveniently enough you don't even need stables, but can summon it any time you like.
achievement.189.name: Natural Born Cowboy
achievement.190.description: Stones have always fascinated you. So has the chance of finding something really precious inside one of them. Statistically you should've discovered a few nice treasures by now. But then again, most statistics are overriden by Mother Disfortune.
achievement.190.name: Petrologist
achievement.191.description: You've discovered the Ancients' hidden powers - from now on, they will aid you in your adventures.
achievement.191.name: Hidden Powers
achievement.192.description: You definitely know how to bring out the best in your furniture and decoration pieces. Beautiful.
achievement.192.name: I Like it Fancy
achievement.193.description: You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
achievement.193.name: Skin-Deep
achievement.194.description: Staking vampires and demons has almost turned into your profession. You make sure to gather even the tiniest amount of evil dust particles. Beware of silicosis.
achievement.194.name: Ashes to Dust
achievement.196.description: Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
achievement.196.name: Safely Stored Away
achievement.197.description: By the gods! What was that?
achievement.197.name: Something's in There
achievement.198.description: Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
achievement.198.name: Silent Pet
achievement.199.description: Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
achievement.199.name: Snowbunny
achievement.200.description: Sinister curses, evil magic - you don't shy away from punishing others by questionable means. Someone just gave you a strange look - now where's that needle again?
achievement.200.name: Dark Voodoo Priest
achievement.201.description: Home is where your current favourite hunting ground is, and though you might hold certain places more dear than others you never feel attached enough to really stay in one city for long. Pack all your stuff - it's time to move on again.
achievement.201.name: Nomad Soul
achievement.202.description: You told Jack the truth by explaining you and Spectulus made a mistake when trying to convince him of being a completely different person.
achievement.202.name: Truth Be Told
achievement.203.description: You did not tell Jack the truth about the mistake you and Spectulus made when trying to convince him about being a completely different person. He will live in doubt until the end of his existence.
achievement.203.name: You Don't Know Jack
achievement.204.description: The Combined Magical Winterberry Society hereby honours continued selfless dedication and extraordinary efforts in the Annual Autumn Vintage.
achievement.204.name: Berry Picker
achievement.205.description: You and your friends showed the three wizards your loyalty three times - I am sure at least one of them is probably eternally thankful and exceedingly proud of you.
achievement.205.name: True Colours
achievement.206.description: You have mastered Kuriks challenge in all possible shapes.
achievement.206.name: Master Shapeshifter
achievement.207.description: With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
achievement.207.name: Slimer
achievement.208.description: You killed the raging mage in his tower south of Zao. Again. But this one just keeps coming back. The dimensional portal collapsed once more and you know he will eventually return but hey - a raging mage, it's like asking for it...
achievement.208.name: Mageslayer
achievement.209.description: You caught fifty rare shimmer swimmers. Getting rid of all those corpses by dumping them into the lake really was worth it, wasn't it? Wait, didn't something move in the water just now...?
achievement.209.name: Biodegradable
achievement.210.description: You didn't look into it - at least not for too long... but Groam did. And you relieved him. Just don't tell his friend Dronk.
achievement.210.name: Eye of the Deep
achievement.211.description: Many creatures of the deep have lost their lives by your hand. Three hundred have entered the depths of eternity. You should probably fear the revenge of the Eyes of the Deep.
achievement.211.name: Invader of the Deep
achievement.212.description: You extinguished 500 thornfires! You were there when the Firestarters took over Shadowthorn. You saved the day - and the home of some elves which will try to kill you nonetheless. Isn't it nice to see everything restored just as it was before..?
achievement.212.name: Firefighter
achievement.213.description: You managed to kill more than four hundred white deer - it looks like you are one of the main reasons they will soon be considered extinct, way to go!
achievement.213.name: Deer Hunt
achievement.214.description: You are now the royal archfiend of the Askarak, prince slayer.
achievement.214.name: Askarak Nemesis
achievement.215.description: You are now the public archenemy of the Shaburak, prince slayer.
achievement.215.name: Shaburak Nemesis
achievement.216.description: You broke the jar of Horestis - fifty times. Either you know no fear or simply ignore it. Whatever the case, you are "fearless" indeed.
achievement.216.name: Fearless
achievement.217.description: Did someone call a doctor? You delivered 100 medicine bags to Ottokar of the Venore poor house in times of dire need, well done!
achievement.217.name: Doctor! Doctor!
achievement.218.description: You significantly helped the afflicted citizens of Venore in times of dire need. Somehow you still feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, one poor soul amongst the countless afflicted.
achievement.218.name: Beak Doctor
achievement.219.description: You vanquished the mad mage, you subdued the raging mage - no spellweaving self-exposer can stand in your way. Yet you are quite absorbed in magical studies yourself. This very fabric reflects this personal approval of the magic arts.
achievement.219.name: Mystic Fabric Magic
achievement.221.description: You've shattered each of Bloodweb's eight frozen legs. As they say: break a leg, and then some more.
achievement.221.name: Arachnoise
achievement.222.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
achievement.222.name: Rootless Behaviour
achievement.223.description: You've slain Esmeralda, the most hideous and aggressive of the mutated rats. No one will know that you almost lost a finger in the process.
achievement.223.name: Twisted Mutation
achievement.224.description: Ethershreck's cry of agony kept ringing in your ear for hours after he had dissolved into thin air. He probably moved to another plane of existence... for a while.
achievement.224.name: Beautiful Agony
achievement.225.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
achievement.225.name: Scorched Flames
achievement.226.description: You ripped the ancient scarab Fleshcrawler apart and made sure he didn't get under your skin.
achievement.226.name: Crawling Death
achievement.227.description: You made a knot with Gorgo's living curls and took her scalp. You couldn't save her countless petrified victims, but at least you didn't become one.
achievement.227.name: The Serpent's Bride
achievement.228.description: You've found a well-hidden spider queen and caught her off guard in the middle of her meal.
achievement.228.name: No More Hiding
achievement.229.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
achievement.229.name: The Gates of Hell
achievement.230.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
achievement.230.name: The Drowned Sea God
achievement.231.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
achievement.231.name: Spareribs for Dinner
achievement.232.description: You almost made friends with Shardhead... before he died. Poor guy only seems to attract violence with his frosty attitude.
achievement.232.name: Breaking the Ice
achievement.233.description: Stonecracker's head was much softer than the stones he threw at you.
achievement.233.name: Just Cracked Me Up!
achievement.234.description: You've exinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
achievement.234.name: Something Smells
achievement.235.description: You've impaled the big mammoth Bloodtusk with his own tusks.
achievement.235.name: Meat Skewer
achievement.236.description: The Many is no more, but how many more are there? One can never know.
achievement.236.name: One Less
achievement.237.description: You've vanquished the Noxious Spawn and his serpentine heart.
achievement.237.name: Hissing Downfall
achievement.238.description: The Old Widow fell prey to your supreme hunting skills.
achievement.238.name: Choking on Her Venom
achievement.239.description: You've tainted the jungle floor with the Snapper's crimson blood.
achievement.239.name: Blood-Red Snapper
achievement.240.description: You've cut off a whole lot of tentacles today. Thul was driven back to where he belongs.
achievement.240.name: Back into the Abyss
achievement.241.description: You've faced and defeated a lot of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.241.name: Pwned a Lot of Fur
achievement.242.description: You've stopped the bank robber and returned the bag full of gold. Good to know there are still lawful Tibians like you around.
achievement.242.name: Honest Finder
achievement.243.description: If it wasn't for you, several banks in Tibia would've gotten bankrupt by now. Keep on chasing bank robbers and no one will have to worry about the Tibian economy!
achievement.243.name: Goldhunter
achievement.244.description: You've discovered a trail of giant footprints and terrified elephants running everywhere. Could it be that the mysterious ape god is rambling in the jungle?
achievement.244.name: Trail of the Ape God
achievement.245.description: That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
achievement.245.name: Someone's Bored
achievement.246.description: You can't keep a secret, can you? Then again, you're just fulfilling your duty to the Queen of Carlin as a lawful citizen. That's a good thing, isn't it...?
achievement.246.name: Whistle-Blower
achievement.247.description: Wyda seems to be really, really bored. You also found out that she doesn't really need all those blood herbs that adventurers brought her. Still, she was nice enough to take one from you and gave you something quite cool in exchange.
achievement.247.name: Torn Treasures
achievement.248.description: You joined the Kingsday festivities and payed King Tibianus your respects. Now, off to party!
achievement.248.name: Loyal Subject
achievement.249.description: You managed to catch a fish in a surrounding that usually doesn't even carry water. Everything is subject to change, probably...
achievement.249.name: Desert Fisher
achievement.251.description: You showed Noodles the way home. How long will it take this time until he's on the loose again? That dog must be really bored in the throne room by now.
achievement.251.name: Dog Sitter
achievement.252.description: You witnessed the thawing of Svargrond and harvested rare seeds from some strange icy plants. They must be good for something.
achievement.252.name: Ice Harvester
achievement.253.description: You are a pretty smart thinker and managed to create everlasting flowers. They might become a big hit with all the people who aren't blessed with a green thumb or just forgetful.
achievement.253.name: Preservationist
achievement.254.description: You've discovered three nomad camps and stole their supplies. Well, you can probably use them better then they can.
achievement.254.name: Chest Robber
achievement.255.description: You've found a secret dungeon in the flooded plains and killed several of its inhabitants. And now you have wet feet.
achievement.255.name: Down the Drain
achievement.256.description: You've survived the Hellgorge eruption and found a way through the flames and lava. You've even managed to kill a few fireborn on the way.
achievement.256.name: Fire from the Earth
achievement.257.description: Your actions start to make a difference. You have blinded the antennae of the hive often enough to become an annoyance to it.
achievement.257.name: Minor Disturbance
achievement.258.description: In the war against the hive, your efforts in blinding it begin to pay off. Your actions have blinded the hive severely and the entity seems to become aware that something dangerous is happening.
achievement.258.name: Dazzler
achievement.259.description: You have put a lot of time and energy into keeping the hive unaware of what is happening on Quirefang. The hive learnt to fear your actions. It would surely crush you with all its might ... if it could only find you!
achievement.259.name: Hive Blinder
achievement.260.description: You have grown accustomed to frequenting the hive's stomach system. Your actions have caused the hive some first digestion problems.
achievement.260.name: Hickup
achievement.261.description: Never-tiring, you attack the inner organs of the mighty hive. Your attacks on the hive's digestion system begin to cause some trouble.
achievement.261.name: Heartburn
achievement.262.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
achievement.262.name: Stomach Ulcer
achievement.263.description: The hive has to be fought with might and main, hampering its soldiers is only the first step. You diligently stopped the pores of the hive to spread its warriors.
achievement.263.name: Planter
achievement.264.description: You are getting more and more experienced in destroying the supply of the enemy's forces. Your actions caused the hive some severe skin problems.
achievement.264.name: Pimple
achievement.265.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
achievement.265.name: Suppressor
achievement.266.description: By killing creatures of the hive and gaining weapons for further missions, you started a quite effective way of war. You gathered a lot of dissolved chitin to resupply the war effort.
achievement.266.name: Gatherer
achievement.267.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
achievement.267.name: Supplier
achievement.268.description: You have become competent and efficient in gathering the substance that is needed to fight the hive. You almost smell like dissolved chitin and the Hive Born would tell their children scary stories about you if they could speak.
achievement.268.name: Chitin Bane
achievement.269.description: You have proven that you can beat the best of the hive. You have caused first promising breaches in the defence of the hive
achievement.269.name: Guard Killer
achievement.270.description: The most powerful warriors of the hive were killed by you by the dozens. The hive is not safe anymore because of your actions.
achievement.270.name: Hive Infiltrator
achievement.271.description: Efficient and lethal, you have gained significant experience in fighting the elite forces of the hive. Almost single-handed, you have slain the best of the Hive Born and live to tell the tale.
achievement.271.name: Exterminator
achievement.272.description: Even in the deepest structures of the hive, you began to strike against the mighty foe. Your actions probably already gave the hive a headache.
achievement.272.name: Headache
achievement.273.description: The destruction you have caused by now can be felt throughout the whole hive. The mayhem that follows your step caused significant confusion in the consciousness of the hive.
achievement.273.name: Confusion
achievement.274.description: You have destroyed a significant amount of the hive's vital nerve centers and caused massive destruction to the hive's awareness. You are probably causing the hive horrible nightmares.
achievement.274.name: Manic
achievement.276.name: Navigational Error
achievement.277.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
achievement.277.name: Si, Ariki!
achievement.278.description: You ended the life of over three hundred Deepling Guards. Not quite the guardian of the Deeplings, are you?
achievement.278.name: Guardian Downfall
achievement.279.description: You hushed the songs of war in the black depths by sliencing more than three hundred Deepling Spellsingers.
achievement.279.name: Death Song
achievement.280.description: By eliminating at least three hundred Deepling Warriors you delivered quite a blow to the amassing armies of the deep.
achievement.280.name: Depth Dwellers
achievement.281.description: You cut your first gem - and it bears your own name! Now that would be a nice gift! This does not make it a "true" Heart of the Sea, however...
achievement.281.name: Gem Cutter
achievement.282.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
achievement.282.name: Spolium Profundis
achievement.283.description: Countless fights and never tiring effort in the war against the hive grant you the experience to finish your outfit with the last remaining part. Your chitin outfit is a testament of your skills and dedication for the cause.
achievement.283.name: Bane of the Hive
achievement.285.description: Your invaluable experience in fighting the hive allows you to add another piece of armor to your chitin outfit to prove your dedication for the cause.
achievement.285.name: Hive War Veteran
achievement.286.description: You have participated that much in the hive war, that you are able to create some makeshift armor from the remains of dead hive born that can be found in the major hive, to show of your skill.
achievement.286.name: Hive Fighter
achievement.287.description: You muted the everlasting howling of Hemming.
achievement.287.name: Howly Silence
achievement.288.description: No more fear and bad dreams. You stabbed Tormentor to death with its scythe leg.
achievement.288.name: Dream's Over
achievement.289.description: You wiped Fazzrah away - zzeemzz like now you're the captain.
achievement.289.name: Zzztill Zzztanding!
achievement.290.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
achievement.290.name: Stepped on a Big Toe
achievement.291.description: No joke, you murdered the bat.
achievement.291.name: Kapow!
achievement.292.description: You gave zzze draken a tazte of your finizzzing move.
achievement.292.name: Enter zze Draken!
achievement.293.description: Bretzecutioner's body just got slammed away. You are a true king of the ring!
achievement.293.name: King of the Ring
achievement.294.description: You overcame the undead Zanakeph and sent him back into the darkness that spawned him.
achievement.294.name: Back from the Dead
achievement.295.description: You've faced and defeated each of the mighty bosses the Paw and Fur society sent you out to kill. All by yourself. What a hunt!
achievement.295.name: Pwned All Fur
achievement.297.description: You lend a helping hand in defeating invading Orcs by destroying their warcamp along with their leader. Bibby's personal bloodbath...
achievement.297.name: Bibby's Bloodbath
achievement.298.description: You cleansed the land from an eight legged nuisance by defeating Mamma Longlegs three times. She won't be back soon... or will she?
achievement.298.name: Nestling
achievement.299.description: You did it! You convinced the reclusive gnomes to accept you as one of their Bigfoots. Now you are ready to help them. With big feet big missions seen to come.
achievement.299.name: Becoming a Bigfoot
achievement.300.description: You think the gnomes start to like you. A little step for a Bigfoot but a big step for humanity.
achievement.300.name: Gnome Little Helper
achievement.301.description: The gnomes are warming up to you. One or two of them might actually bother to remember your name. You're allowed to access their gnomebase alpha. You are prepared to boldly put your big feet into areas few humans have walked before.
achievement.301.name: Gnome Friend
achievement.302.description: You have become a household name in gnomish society! Your name is mentioned by gnomes more than once. Of course usually by gnomish mothers whose children refuse to eat their mushroom soup, but you are certainly making some tremendous progress.
achievement.302.name: Gnomelike
achievement.303.description: You accomplished what few humans ever will: you truly impressed the gnomes. This might not change their outlook on humanity as a whole, but at least you can bathe in gnomish respect! And don't forget you're now allowed to enter the warzones!
achievement.303.name: Honorary Gnome
achievement.304.description: You brought two loving crystals together. Perhaps they might even name one of their children after you. Too bad you forgot to leave your calling card.
achievement.304.name: Crystals in Love
achievement.305.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
achievement.305.name: Substitute Tinker
achievement.306.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
achievement.306.name: Spore Hunter
achievement.307.description: Burnt fingers and itching lungs are a small price for bringing those gnomes some lousy stone and getting almost killed! Your mother warned you to better become a farmer.
achievement.307.name: Grinding Again
achievement.308.description: Seen it all. Done it all. Your unstoppable force swept through the dungeons and you vanquished their masters. Not to forget the precious loot you took! Now stop reading this and continue hunting! Time is money after all!
achievement.308.name: Dungeon Cleaner
achievement.309.description: So you repaired the light of some crystals for those gnomes. What's next? Sitting a week in a mushroom bed as a temporary mushroom?
achievement.309.name: Crystal Keeper
achievement.310.description: Admittedly you enjoyed the killing as usual. But the part with the sparks still gives you shivers ... or is it that there is some charge left on you?
achievement.310.name: Call Me Sparky
achievement.311.description: One Bigfoot won over thousands of tiny feet. Perhaps the gnomes are wrong and size matters?
achievement.311.name: One Foot Vs. Many
achievement.312.description: The gnomes decided their pigs need some exclusive diet and you had to do all the dirty work - but wasn't the piglet adorable?
achievement.312.name: The Picky Pig
achievement.313.description: You killed the ambassador of the abyss that often that they might consider sending another one. Perhaps that will one day stop further intrusions.
achievement.313.name: Diplomatic Immunity
achievement.314.description: Have you ever wondered how he reappears again and again? You only care for the loot, do you? Gotcha!
achievement.314.name: Fall of the Fallen
achievement.315.description: Again and again Deathstrike has fallen to your prowess. Perhaps it's time for people calling YOU Deathstrike from now on.
achievement.315.name: Death on Strike
achievement.316.description: The face of the enemy is unmasked. You have encountered one of 'those below' and survived. More than that, you managed to kill the beast and prove once and for all that the enemy can be beaten.
achievement.316.name: Death from Below
achievement.317.description: The fallen gnome is dead and justice served. But what was it that the gnome whispered with his last breath? He's your father???
achievement.317.name: Gnomebane's Bane
achievement.318.description: The mighty Deathstrike is dead! One legend is dead and you're on your way to become one yourself.
achievement.318.name: Final Strike
achievement.319.description: Seeing a mucus plug makes your heart dance and you can't resist to see what it hides. Goo goo away!
achievement.319.name: Goo Goo Dancer
achievement.320.description: Finally your dream to become a walking mushroom has come true ... No, wait a minute!
achievement.320.name: Funghitastic
achievement.321.description: If the gnomes had told you that crystal armor is see-through you had probably changed your underwear in time.
achievement.321.name: Crystal Clear
achievement.322.description: You have unleashed your inner gnome and slain some of the most fearsome threats that gnomekind has ever faced. Now you can come and go to the warzones as it pleases you. The enemies of gnomekind will never be safe again.
achievement.322.name: Gnomish Art Of War
achievement.324.description: You conquered the demon challenge and prevailed... now show off your success in style!
achievement.324.name: True Dedication
achievement.325.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
achievement.325.name: Task Manager
achievement.326.description: Assisting Omrabas' sick plan to resurrect made you dig your way through the blood-soaked halls of Drefia. Maybe better he failed!
achievement.326.name: Gravedigger
achievement.327.description: You cleansed your soul in serving the Repenter enclave and purified thine self in completing all tasks in a single day of labour.
achievement.327.name: Repenter
achievement.328.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your blade into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.328.name: Umbral Swordsman
achievement.331.description: You have helped the gnomes of the spike in securing the caves and explored enough of the lightles depths to earn you a complete cave explorers outfit. Well done!
achievement.331.name: Cave Completionist
achievement.332.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your slayer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.332.name: Umbral Bladelord
achievement.333.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your axe into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.333.name: Umbral Headsman
achievement.334.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your chopper into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.334.name: Umbral Executioner
achievement.335.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your mace into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.335.name: Umbral Brawler
achievement.336.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your hammer into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.336.name: Umbral Berserker
achievement.337.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your bow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.337.name: Umbral Archer
achievement.338.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your crossbow into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.338.name: Umbral Marksman
achievement.339.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify your spellbook into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world.
achievement.339.name: Umbral Harbinger
achievement.340.description: You managed to transform, improve and sacrify all kinds of weapons into a master state and have proven yourself worthy in a nightmarish world. Respect!
achievement.340.name: Umbral Master
achievement.341.description: You collected all of the mysterious bottle messages around the island of Roshamuul and located the remains of the first mate. Time will tell if his tale of mending an evil ring holds true.
achievement.341.name: Nevermending Story
achievement.342.description: What a scientific discovery - they really DO communicate! Using their own communication habits against them, you lured a large pack of silencers away from the walls of Roshamuul.
achievement.342.name: Luring Silence
achievement.343.description: You did not show any signs of surrender to any sight of... you get the picture. Even a hundred of them did not pose a threat to you.
achievement.343.name: Never Surrender
achievement.344.description: You have mended many a broken dream and so, the dream of Roshamuul is safely being told over and over again.
achievement.344.name: Dream Wright
achievement.345.description: You have cleansed the lands of many retching horrors. You sure know how to end a bad dream: forcefully, that's how!
achievement.345.name: Ending the Horror
achievement.346.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
achievement.346.name: Sleepwalking
achievement.347.description: It doesn't matter what noise you would hear... dream, nightmare, illusion - there is nothing you can't vanquish. You are a true Dream Warden.
achievement.347.name: Dream Warden
achievement.348.description: Gaz'haragoth... a day to remember! Your world accomplished something really big - and you have been part of it!
achievement.348.name: Prison Break
achievement.349.description: After a battle like this you know who your friends are.
achievement.349.name: Noblesse Obliterated
